seam_probes.law: compressed loads X_p = P_p/4 (+) Q_p/6; seam probe = compressed disagreement projector of the seam in each sector
seam_probes.conclusion: seam probes leave the twelve-dimensional port algebra: with them the response is u(3) + u(2), dimension 13, centre 2
seam_probes.framed_quanta: the position register is dephased by the reference instrument, so a seam hop probe has no first-order response; sums N_a + N_b are sums of port probes

audit_encoded_controller.response: X_p = P_p/2 (+) -Q_p/2 with the audit's Pauli ordering; implementers W(q) of the audit
audit_encoded_controller.reading: exp(i s X_p) exp(-i s X_pbar) = W(q) for a lift q of a rotation about port p: the declared transport gates of the encoded controller are words in its own response pulses
